verdict.rationale: The GST portal documents a remote credential login flow covering first-time login, subsequent login, username/password retrieval and password change [gst-india-docs-10]. It also documents remote verification by DSC or Electronic Verification Code (EVC) [gst-india-docs-9, gst-india-docs-8], and nothing in the pack points to biometric, in-person or postal-PIN requirements. However, the evidence is only one-line help-module titles and never confirms that sign-in itself uses a second factor, so the MFA part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that login uses OTP or other MFA, confirmation that no Aadhaar biometric, in-person or mailed-PIN step is needed for the authorized signatory, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the remote sign-in flow.
